Ana (Marketing): Quick one 1: pick final webinar topic: 'Inference runbook: benchmarks that move procurement' or 'Latency-first serving patterns'. Leaning to runbook. Thoughts?
Ben (Growth): Runbook wins for demand gen. More actionable messaging = higher conversion.
Clara (Content): Agree. I'll write two variants of landing copy (short + long) and a 30s trailer. Posting drafts later today.
Dax (Eng): I'll own demo infra. Plan: non-prod endpoint + precomputed fallback + a small script to failover at 5s.
Ana (Marketing): Rehearsal windows: Wed 09:00 PT tech check, Fri 09:00 PT dress. Can presenters make one of those?
Ben (Growth): Wed ok, Fri tight but can join last 20.
Clara (Content): Fri dress only, but I'll upload speaker notes beforehand.
Dax (Eng): Both slots free. I'll prep the curl snippet and host fallback screenshot.
WebinarBot: Event created: "Inference runbook" 1 Tech check Wed 2024-06-12 09:00 PT, Dress Fri 2024-06-14 09:00 PT. Invites sent.
Ana (Marketing): Run-of-show (draft): 00:00-00:45 intro; 00:45-04:00 buyer pain; 04:00-10:00 benchmark methodology; 10:00-16:00 live compare + fallback; 16:00-20:00 TL;DR + CTA; 20:00-30:00 Q&A.
Clara (Content): Landing blurb (v1): "Practical inference runbook: real benchmarks, operational knobs, and the playbook teams use to cut unit cost without regressing latency." Add attendee callout?
Ana (Marketing): Add: "For platform, infra, and product teams." Also include registration fields: role, main inference pain, and consent. Ben, can you map routing?
Ben (Growth): Yep 1 I'll map roles to SDR queue and create a segment for 'high spend' responses.
Ana (Marketing): Action items: Clara finalize abstracts by EOD tomorrow; Dax upload demo assets; Ben set routing and promo calendar; Ana send invites + recording ops. Reply here when done.
Dax (Eng): Demo assets uploaded and curl snippet in Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake-demo-link
Clara (Content): Abstracts uploaded (v1).
Ben (Growth): Promo calendar set. Will queue creatives once abstracts final.
Ana (Marketing): Great, closing thread unless blockers. :rocket:
